messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: P1 pager — auth-service: sudden spike in 401s and anomalous header entropy from IP 52.14.33.7. Possible token replay or header injection. Top affected route: /v1/session/validate. Alerting on-call. Runbook: https://wiki.redwood/self-serve/incident-runbooks#auth

dave: I’m oncall. Acknowledge. spinning up triage channel now. tagging sec and infra. @carla @bob

carla: on it. initial ask: are customers impacted (401 vs 403)? any pattern by tenant id?

bob: seeing same. quick query: `SELECT count(*) FROM auth_logs WHERE status=401 AND src_ip='52.14.33.7' AND ts > now()-interval '5m';` returns ~2.3k events in last 5m. headers look weird — x-session-id repeating across requests.

alice: adding logs from edge: ```
[2026-02-18T15:04:12Z] src=52.14.33.7 method=POST path=/v1/session/validate status=401 hdr_x-session-id=abc123abc123 user_agent=python-requests/2.31
[2026-02-18T15:04:13Z] src=52.14.33.7 method=POST path=/v1/session/validate status=401 hdr_x-session-id=abc123abc123
```

carla: x-session-id repeating is suspicious — looks like replayed tokens or a leaked header value. Can we identify which service issued that session id? correlate against session store.

bob: running correlation against kv-store. Preliminary: session id `abc123abc123` maps to svcacct:staging-ingest (service principal). Looks like a service account token may be leaked or being replayed.

eva: heads-up — we have live customer requests hitting endpoints. If this becomes broader we should prepare customer comms. Waiting on impact numbers.

liam: routing policy note — traffic is coming across two regions (us-east-1 and eu-west-1) simultaneously. Could be distributed probe. Suggest WAF rule to block src ip and rate-limit similar header values.

dave: decision checklist: 1) block IPs + tighten WAF 2) rotate staging-ingest service account key 3) add filter to scrub session ids from logs and revoke leaked sessions 4) escalate to legal if customer data exfil confirmed. Agree? :thumbsup:

carla: agree. I'll own the key rotation and session revocation. bob, can you apply WAF quick rule and add temporary rate cap on /v1/session/validate?

bob: applying WAF rule now: `block ip 52.14.33.7` + `rate-limit hdr_x-session-id > 50req/min -> 429` — patching edge in ~90s. Posting config diff: ```
- allow
+ block ip 52.14.33.7
+ add rule: header_clash_rate_limit
```

alice: started scrubbing pipeline for logs — remove hdr_x-session-id values older than 24h and mark affected logs for redaction. Running one-shot scrub job.

carla: rotating staging-ingest keys. Orchestrating with IAM: creating new key, updating deployment secrets, and rotating consumers. ETA 8m for rotation and staged cutover. Will revoke old key after verification.

dave: assign primary: carla (security lead), bob (infra action), alice (logs + telemetry), liam (routing fallback). I'll coordinate pager duties and customer comms with eva.

eva: prepping customer-impact note draft: short summary + mitigation steps + ETA for full rotation. No evidence yet of customer data exfil. Will wait for confirmation before sending.

carla: rotation progress: new key issued, rolling update to staging-ingest pods underway (k8s rollout). `kubectl rollout status deploy/staging-ingest` shows 2/3 updated, one pod restarted with new secret.

bob: WAF rule active across both regions. Traffic drop observed (401 events down from ~2.3k -> ~120 in last 2m). Blocking IPs and abnormal header rates appears effective.

alice: scrub job finished initial pass — redacted ~1.2k log entries, created audit artifact tracking redactions. Telemetry shows anomalous header values now suppressed.

carla: rotation done. Old key revoked. Performing session-store sweep for sessions issued by staging-ingest; revoking any session tied to that svcacct. Running post-rotate validation.

dave: good work. Next steps: monitor for 1h, keep WAF block for 24h, follow-up incident writeup and timeline. If any customer impact confirmed, escalate to legal and send CS note. I’ll hand off to oncall followup shift at 16:00 UTC.

liam: adding follow-up action: add alert to detect identical hdr_x-session-id across >5 distinct src_ips in 1m window (to catch replay).

carla: note to security: open ticket SEC-2026-1347 with timeline and indicators. Attaching redaction artifact and rotation logs.

eva: thanks team — will hold draft and stand by for final confirmation. :lock:

IncidentBot: Incident updated — status: mitigated (partial). Incident owner: carla. Follow-up channel: #incidents-postmortem-5543210000. Runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/incidents/SEC-2026-1347"
